Title: Questions about a few specific political action cards.

Messages.Author: theoperat0r
Messages.Body:
Hi,
Thank you in advance for any clarification you can provide, I have searched the web, but can find no answers for my questions.

1st. When I play Kine Resources Contested, could I assign 0 points to myself (or another player) and 4 points to my prey?

2nd. Can I play Reckless Agitation when the game is reduced to only two players? (and would it make a difference if there were only two players to start?)

Thanks,

Tim

Messages.Author: nicktaruffi
Messages.Body:

2) dunno! Don't know the card sorry!  :p

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> theoperat0r wrote:
> 1st. When I play Kine Resources Contested, could I assign 0 points to myself (or another player) and 4 points to my prey?
No. You must divide the points among 2 or more Methuselahs. Giving 0 to a Methuselah doesn't count that Methuselah as being one of the group to whom the points are given.

> theoperat0r wrote:
> 2nd. Can I play Reckless Agitation when the game is reduced to only two players? (and would it make a difference if there were only two players to start?)
No and no. There must be two other Methuselahs in the game to target in order to play Reckless Agitation.
